<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT"/>
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.VIBRATE"/>

    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.camera" android:required="false"/>
    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.microphone" android:required="false"/>

    <application
        android:name=".NexusApp"
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.NexusGo">

        <activity android:name=".SplashActivity" android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <activity android:name=".auth.LoginActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".auth.SignupActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".auth.ProfileSetupActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".MainActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".chat.ChatActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".friends.AddFriendActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".profile.ProfileActivity"/>
        <activity android:name=".call.CallActivity" android:showWhenLocked="true" android:turnScreenOn="true"/>
        <activity android:name=".call.IncomingCallActivity" android:showWhenLocked="true" android:turnScreenOn="true"/>

        <service
            android:name=".service.NexusForegroundService"
            android:foregroundServiceType="microphone"
            android:exported="false"/>

        <service
            android:name=".service.NexusFirebaseMessagingService"
            android:exported="false">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="com.google.firebase.MESSAGING_EVENT"/>
            </intent-filter>
        </service>
    </application>
</manifest>

<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/bg_dark">

    <FrameLayout android:id="@+id/container"
        android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottom_nav"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"/>

    <com.google.android.material.bottomnavigation.BottomNavigationView
        android:id="@+id/bottom_nav"
        android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="@color/bg_card"
        app:itemIconTint="@color/text_primary"
        app:itemTextColor="@color/text_primary"
        app:menu="@menu/bottom_nav"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"/>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical" android:background="@color/bg_dark">

    <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="12dp"
        android:background="@color/bg_card" android:gravity="center_vertical">
        <ImageView android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:background="@drawable/circle_dark" android:src="@drawable/ic_person"/>
        <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp">
            <TextView android:id="@+id/tv_name" android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                android:textStyle="bold"/>
            <TextView android:id="@+id/tv_typing" android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="typing…"
                android:visibility="gone" android:textColor="@color/accent" android:textSize="12sp"/>
        </LinearLayout>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_call" android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:src="@drawable/ic_call"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"/>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_vcall" android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:src="@drawable/ic_video"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/rv_messages"
        android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="8dp"/>

    <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="8dp"
        android:background="@color/bg_card">
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_ghost" android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:src="@drawable/ic_ghost"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"/>
        <EditText android:id="@+id/et_message" android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1"
            android:hint="Message" android:textColor="@color/text_primary"/>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_send" android:layout_width="48dp"
            android:layout_height="48dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_send"
            android:background="@drawable/circle_dark"/>
    </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/black">

    <org.webrtc.SurfaceViewRenderer android:id="@+id/remote_view"
        android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent"/>

    <org.webrtc.SurfaceViewRenderer android:id="@+id/local_view"
        android:layout_width="120dp" android:layout_height="160dp"
        android:layout_gravity="top|end" android:layout_margin="16dp"/>

    <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_gravity="bottom" android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:gravity="center" android:padding="24dp">
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_mute" android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp" android:background="@drawable/circle_dark"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_call"/>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_swap" android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp" android:background="@drawable/circle_dark"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_video" android:layout_marginStart="16dp"/>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_cam" android:layout_width="56dp"
            android:layout_height="56dp" android:background="@drawable/circle_dark"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_video" android:layout_marginStart="16dp"/>
        <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btn_end" android:layout_width="64dp"
            android:layout_height="64dp" android:backgroundTint="#E53935"
            android:background="@drawable/circle_dark"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_end" android:layout_marginStart="24dp"/>
    </LinearLayout>
</FrameLayout>

#!/usr/bin/env bash
###############################################################################
# Android SDK setup for Nexus Go (Codespaces / devcontainer / Linux)
###############################################################################
set -euo pipefail

SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/android-sdk}"
CLI_VERSION="11076708"   # commandlinetools build (latest stable)
CLI_ZIP="commandlinetools-linux-${CLI_VERSION}_latest.zip"

echo "==> Installing Android SDK to ${SDK_ROOT}"
mkdir -p "${SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools"
cd "${SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools"

if [ ! -d latest ]; then
    echo "==> Downloading command-line tools"
    wget -q "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/${CLI_ZIP}"
    unzip -q "${CLI_ZIP}"
    mv cmdline-tools latest
    rm -f "${CLI_ZIP}"
fi

# Persist environment for current and future shells
export ANDROID_HOME="${SDK_ROOT}"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${SDK_ROOT}"
export PATH="${PATH}:${SDK_ROOT}/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:${SDK_ROOT}/platform-tools"

if ! grep -q "ANDROID_HOME" "${HOME}/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null; then
    {
        echo ""
        echo "# Android SDK"
        echo "export ANDROID_HOME=${SDK_ROOT}"
        echo "export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=${SDK_ROOT}"
        echo "export PATH=\$PATH:\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools"
    } >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
fi

echo "==> Accepting licenses"
yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null

echo "==> Installing platform + build tools"
sdkmanager --install \
    "platform-tools" \
    "platforms;android-34" \
    "build-tools;34.0.0" >/dev/null

echo ""
echo "==> Done."
echo "    ANDROID_HOME = ${SDK_ROOT}"
echo "    Reload your shell or run:  source ~/.bashrc"
